messages:
marina: Quick sync — I'm proposing a new routing knob: `region_prefetch` (affinity+speculative fallback). Prefers local region, but will prefetch to a failover region when latency > 120ms or when local quota < 20%. Want opinions on header semantics and console rollout UX.
aj: Quick q — if a client supplies `X-Region-Preference`, should that always win over our geo inference? or do we still apply quota checks first?
devin: I vote header wins for customer intent, but still enforce per-tenant quota and per-region capacity. header = strong hint, not hard pin.
sre-ravi: Concern: prefetching to fallback region doubles token cost for those requests. need a quota attribution plan and opt-in per-tenant otherwise billing shock.
hannah: For the console: we can expose a toggle per-tenant: Off / Prefetch(soft) / Prefetch(strict). Soft = prefetch only when latency spikes, Strict = always prefetch to maintain QoS. Add telemetry to show % of prefetched requests and extra cost.
marina: Good. On header precedence proposal: implement precedence order = explicit header > route policy > inferred geo. But allow tenant override in console to pin route policy. That addresses compliance cases.
aj: How do we represent prefetch decisions in headers/logs? We need a consistent contract for downstream services and audit.
devin: Add `X-Redwood-Routing: prefetched=1;primary=us-west-2;secondary=eu-west-1` in response headers. Log `routing.prefetch` boolean in telemetry sample.
sre-ravi: +1 on the header. For quota attribution: charge primary region first; if primary out-of-quota then attribute to fallback but mark `prefetch_cost=true` so billing can show breakdown.
marina: Also thinking about tie-breaker when two regions have similar latency. Use capacity-aware weighted randomization: weight = available_capacity * (1 / p95_latency). Example pseudocode:
```
for r in regions:
  score[r] = r.available_slots * (1.0 / max(r.latency_p95, 1))
choose region with prob ~ score / sum(scores)
```
If header pinned a region, force pick that region unless tenant console says "no pin override".
infra-bot: deploy/route-engine v2.14 started by @devin — rolling 6 clusters.
hannah: UX note: when we flip prefetch on for a tenant, show an in-console estimate: extra tokens/month and expected latency reduction. Use historical traces to estimate.
marina: One more: what about stale responses and cache keys? Prefetch could pollute caches. Suggest appending `X-Cache-Distinction: region_prefetch` so we don't mix entries.
devin: Good call. Also, ensure KV cache keys include selected-region to avoid cross-region cache contamination.
aj: Are we comfortable with eventual consistency in telemetry? Console should show prefetched ratio with 1-2 min lag, that's fine.
sre-ravi: Ops ask: include circuit-breaker to disable prefetch globally if cross-region errors > 0.5% in last 10m. Also a per-zone ejection signal.
marina: Action items:
- dev: implement header contract & logging (devin + aj)
- infra: route engine change + circuit-breaker (devin + infra)
- billing: prefetched cost attribution + estimate endpoint (ravi)
- console: toggle + cost estimate + telemetry panel (hannah)
I'll create tickets. If no objections, I'll start a canary rollout for 3 tenants next week. :thumbsup:
hannah: :thumbsup: I'll wire up a mock panel in the console sandbox.
sre-ravi: :thinking: Please keep me looped on canary tenants — want to validate billing path.
marina: Thanks all — creating tickets now. ping me if you want to be on the canary list.
